description: Compare two or three exact formulas from the published AssurancesLabs catalogue, including documented pet waiting periods and school cover. Start without arguments for available panels, exact formula IDs, criteria, editions and review deadlines. Uses the same engine and data as the website. Returns source URLs, document hashes, excerpts, locators, conditions, review dates and a shareable comparison URL. Unknown cells stay unknown, never excluded. Expired and private editions are withheld. No prices, ranking or confirmation of current commercial availability. To request a quote after comparison, call get_quote_requirements for the chosen insurance line; comparison is not eligibility or consent.
name: compare_published_formula_catalogue
